div.div: Each missed item reverses in the next year. An error that recurs every year can leave income nearly right while the balance sheet stays wrong.

div.div: The facts existed at the year-end and were missed or misapplied. The correction goes to the period in which they existed: the prior year's figures are restated, and an earlier error enters opening retained earnings.

div.div: The year-end estimate was reasonable on the facts then available. A later difference goes to the period in which it becomes known, and to later periods if they are affected. Nothing is restated.
